`HashingWriteBuffer` checksums for run files and manifests remain `cityHash128`; only the blob content address is selectable.

A CAS-owned S3 retry controller is required for the ref protocol and provides single-attempt conditional writes, exact-key resolution, and lease gating.

Raw conditional-write results classify as `Committed` for 2xx, `DefiniteFailure` only for whitelisted malformed-request, entity-too-large, or access-denied classes, and `Unresolved` for timeout, connection loss, 5xx, or unresolved `PreconditionFailed`; `PreconditionFailed` is never a definite failure.

Read-only exact `GET` and `HEAD` operations use CAS-bounded retries, paginated `LIST` resumes only with its returned continuation token, immutable conditional creates resolve by exact-key observation, and exact deletes never broaden their target.

`decodeFoldSeal` must reject `TokenType` values outside `ETag`, `Generation`, and `Emulated`, and `RefNsCleanupState` values outside `Pending` and `Completed`, with `CORRUPTED_DATA`.

CAS v3 fixes JSON keys to 2–5 characters, uses full-word values, and requires units to be recorded in the registry; per-object field tables are implementation-plan work under those conventions.

CAS codecs use streaming `ReadHelpers`/`WriteHelpers` JSON primitives over `ReadBuffer` and hand-written deterministic writers; they do not use a DOM library.

Publish-confirm uses protocol version 11 with `content_addressed_confirm` as the confirm action parameter and `content_addressed_source_token` as the relink-offer response cookie.

The HEAD-before-GET pair is a standing-veto protocol step; its cost is measured as the number of edges multiplied by approximately 0.9 ms per round trip, without proposing removal.
An `EpochSeal` transaction contains exactly one seal operation; `prev_epoch_seal` is required on sequence 1 of every non-genesis epoch, including an empty epoch, and is forbidden elsewhere.

`slotOccupy` performs exactly one conditional create and, only on conflict resolution, one raw exact GET; it never lists, never retries internally, and returns `Created`, `Occupied` with occupant bytes/token, or `Unresolved`.

Fold-seal decoding rejects classifications outside `{0,1,2,4}` before narrowing, rejects classification-4 holds with zero `offending_position`, and rejects duplicate `(namespace, shard)` coverage rows; encoders reject the same malformed shapes.

Within one `putIfAbsentControlled` call, `DefiniteFailure` is reported only when every attempt is definite; any earlier unresolved ambiguous attempt dominates the call verdict and preserves `ApplyPending`.
Blob re-hashing establishes content identity, `HEAD`-before-`PUT` is the deduplication admission gate, and a condemned object is never revived by reading it back; revival requires a fresh upload.
The S3 conditional-write policy treats HTTP 412 as deterministic and non-retryable, exposed through `S3Exception::isPreconditionFailed` and `RetryStrategy`.

Identifiers belonging to compare-and-swap rather than the CAS feature are excluded from naming changes, including `casPut`, `CasOutcome`, `CasResult`, `CasOp::Cas`, `CasOp::CasConflict`, and the `CasRequestControl.h` family.
